prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measurements in all three rounds.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns, as only one test has been completed and no clear effect was seen.
Evidence is still thin for sign-in reordering, as only one test has been completed, though that test was helpful (won).
Evidence is still thin for sign-in copy changes, as only one test has been completed and no clear effect was seen.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, copy: -0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Sign-In Shift: Move the sign-in step to occur right after adoption certificate generation so users form an emotional bond before creating an account. (why: Sign-in right after path selection causes early dropoff (76.2% step conversion). Moving sign-in after adoption certificate leverages high user investment.)
1: [home, wait_info] Real-Time Pet Render Status Counter: Add precise dynamic status updates and estimated time remaining indicators on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step dropoff and support reports of desktop pets failing to open stem from lack of feedback during long setup renders.)
2: [choose_path, copy] Clear Path Selection Guidance: Update the choose path headline and hint to clearly explain pre-made vs custom pet creation paths. (why: Choose path takes a mean time of 514s despite being the first step, showing user confusion over which route to take.)
3: [adoption, layout] Photo Upload Guided Split Screen: Switch photo upload layout to a split view showing live image requirements alongside the upload dropzone. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failures or poor rendering results, and adoption mean duration is 1017s.)
4: [home, notification] Pet Ready System Desktop Notification: Enable background desktop notification option on the waiting screen to alert users when rendering finishes. (why: High mean wait times (2336s) cause users to minimize or forget the desktop pet app during background pet generation.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Pet Account Sync Hint: Add prominent sign-in hint clarifying account synchronization to prevent duplicate account creation. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, indicating users sign into wrong or duplicate accounts.)

scores.note: Target step drops 23.8% of users. Past test for sign-in reordering showed positive lift (+3.7%).
Both support emails and long mean duration (2336s) point to render waiting friction.
High mean duration (514s vs 8s median) suggests confusion; copy fix is low cost.
Adoption has highest dropoff (60.9% conv) and support emails, but past adoption redesigns had low lift (+0.2%).
Addresses high wait duration on home screen (2336s mean), but requires system notification code.
Strong support mail evidence (8 emails), but previous sign-in copy change yielded negative lift (-0.6%).
